properties.description:
This permit is to comply the CF-2021-016628 for Partial Demolition without permits and without Right of Way permit from the Street's Department.
*CONTRACTOR HAS NO EMPLOYEES PER NOTARIZED LETTER*
EZ PERMIT STANDARDS ALTERATIONS - For alterations to an Existing One Family Dwelling as per attached standard. Deviations from this standard will result in permit revocation and require submission of construction plans.  Structural alteration or repair is expressly prohibited under this permit. Prohibited structural work any modifications to exterior walls, party walls, floor/roof framing or foundations, including underpinning, excavation, and removal of foundation slab. WORK IN THE BASEMENT OR CELLAR IS NOT INCLUDED ON THE EZ ALT PERMIT. Separate permits required for Mechanical, Electric and Plumbing. Very small upgrades being made throughout the property, no changes occurring to the exterior of the property. Non-structural alterations and there will be no demolition of weight bearing walls.
